answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 19445 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: i would like to know how many wajibaat's are there in namaaz. i have read some books but they are different from each other so please help me.. Question: i would like to know how many wajibaat's are there in namaaz. i have read some books but they are different from each other so please help me.. Answer ID: 19445 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/286/L=1431) Allama Hasan Shurunbulali ( رحمة الله عليه ) in his book "Maraqiul Falah, Sharh Nurul Ezah" has stated 18 wajib acts for salah in a comprehensive and brief way. According to most of the fuqha this number is authentic. However, if some books relate more or less than this number they are either the summary or explanation of these eighteen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
